## Services
- AI Video Creation: Ads, reels and stories generated and directed with AI.
- Video Editing: Short-form and long-form edits with pace, captions and polish.
- Motion Graphics: Animated titles, logos and explainers that move with intent.
- Graphic Design & Thumbnails: Thumbnails, posts and brand visuals made to get the click.
- Websites & Landing Pages: Fast, modern, SEO-ready sites that turn visitors into leads.
- 3D Websites: Interactive Three.js experiences that make people stop and play.
- Apps & Software: Web apps, SaaS tools and dashboards built with an AI-first stack.

## FAQ
### What services do you offer?
AI video creation, video editing, motion graphics, graphic design and thumbnails, websites and landing pages, 3D websites, and apps and software.

### Is the first demo really free?
Yes. Tell me your idea and I'll build a free first demo, so you can see it before you pay anything.

### How long does a project take?
It depends on the scope. Landing pages and short videos usually take a few days; bigger websites and apps take longer. You get a clear timeline after we talk.

### Which AI tools do you use?
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and Gemini for building and writing, AI video tools for creation, and Next.js, React, Supabase and Vercel for the web.
